identity.name: BHARATROHAN AIRBORNE INNOVATIO
identity.industry: Agritech / Precision Farming & Agri-Input Supply Chain

summary.oneLiner: BharatRohan has scaled its CropAssure platform to 2 lakh acres with 55K farmers, monetizing via subscriptions, input sales, and produce trading, while launching a consumer brand for residue-free agri-products; the key inflection is the DGCA-certified Pravir-X6 drone enabling franchise-led spraying services and expansion into non-agri sectors like solar and pharma.

one-line thesis: BharatRohan has scaled its CropAssure platform to 2 lakh acres with 55K farmers, monetizing via subscriptions, input sales, and produce trading, while launching a consumer brand for residue-free agri-products; the key inflection is the DGCA-certified Pravir-X6 drone enabling franchise-led spraying services and expansion into non-agri sectors like solar and pharma.
financial scorecard: Revenue: ₹32 Cr (H1FY26); EBITDA/margin: Not disclosed; PAT (rptd): ₹5 Cr (H1FY26); PAT (normalized): Not adjusted; Order book: ₹0 (no formal order book); Net debt: Not disclosed; One-offs: None reported; Accounting distortions: None noted
guidance: Revenue growth: Targeting ₹500 Cr in 4-5 years; Margin: Not specified; Order inflow: 9,000-acre solar farm POC signed; Capex/commissioning: In-house drone manufacturing scaling; R&D grants underway
order book & pipeline: 9,000-acre solar farm monitoring POC in Bharuch signed; no formal order book established
segment / subsidiary detail: CropAssure: Subscription fees (basic/standard/premium plans) + input sales + produce procurement; SourceAssure: Branded consumer goods sold online/retail with QR traceability; Pravir-X6: DGCA-certified drone for spraying; New POCs: Solar panel inspection, pharmaceutical counterfeiting detection, rubber plantation monitoring
growth verticals / optionality: Expansion into non-agri verticals: solar farm monitoring (9K acres POC), pharma counterfeit detection (chalk vs paracetamol classification), rubber plantation health tracking; Franchise model for drone operators; Export of hyperspectral tech to research institutes
margins & cost dynamics: Farmers earn 26% higher profit margin via advisory; Company's gross margin not disclosed; Cost structure driven by drone ops, R&D, and input procurement; No cost inflation mentioned
capex / expansion: Investing in in-house drone (Pravir-X6) manufacturing; R&D facility setup; Hyperspectral camera production; Grants applied for to fund hardware development
capital allocation: Reinvesting in R&D, drone manufacturing, and scaling franchise network; No dividend or buyback mentioned; Focus on organic growth and tech IP development
risks & watch-items: Farmer adoption rate dependency; Regulatory delays in drone operations; Competition from satellite-based agri-analytics firms; Scalability of franchise model; Low ARPU from non-paying farmers (32K out of 55K)
management quality / tone: Highly confident, visionary, and technology-forward; Emphasis on IP creation, scalability, and multi-sector expansion; Clear focus on building a ₹500 Cr company in 4-5 years; Strong belief in hyperspectral tech as a platform
non-obvious takeaways: The QR-code traceability on consumer packs creates a defensible brand moat in food safety; Hyperspectral imaging for pharma counterfeiting is a high-margin, low-competition niche; DGCA certification enables B2B drone sales — not just services — unlocking a new revenue stream
challenges → beneficiaries & losers:
| Challenge | Beneficiary/Loser | Dir | Conviction | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Farmers lose 25% crops to pests and face export rejections due to chemical residues | BharatRohan Airborne Innovations | beneficiary | High | Solves critical food safety and income gap with tech-enabled precision farming |
| FMCGs need traceable, residue-free raw materials | BharatRohan Airborne Innovations | beneficiary | High | Direct supply chain access to certified produce creates premium B2B contracts |
| Solar plant operators need automated fault detection | BharatRohan Airborne Innovations | beneficiary | Med | 9,000-acre solar POC is early-stage but high-margin potential |
| Pharma companies face counterfeit drug risks | BharatRohan Airborne Innovations | beneficiary | Low | Proof-of-concept exists but commercialization timeline unclear |
